body: Chief: RATIFIED as the spec for the scout's follow-up bd-01M15EG0VX2VE0QKN19WB1EJ14 — the 'always under K' law: key authority is batch-scoped and captured exactly once before any non-public delegation; exactly one AttemptReceipt escapes a batch, under Keyed(K) | Plain (all-public) | Withheld(K) (call-free), with calls == the ProviderCalls actually made. Case 1 (delegate returns K' ≠ K): EmbedError.ReceiptKeyMismatch(K, K'), batch rejected, a FRESH receipt under K with the call list preserved and the foreign body dropped, ResultDecision.ReceiptRejected + every outcome Invalid. Case 2: addResultDecisions takes the batch's immutable SensitiveKeySnapshot (never a provider); the only failure is AuthorityMismatch(stored, supplied), converted like case 1. Case 3: conforming without a key for a non-public batch fails closed before delegation; a Withheld receipt is minted only when a KeyId is known, otherwise Left with no receipt claiming authority. Rejected shapes stand: no carried foreign body, no provider-based re-capture, no mixed-authority receipt (validateProviderReceipts asserts one KeyId). Tests as listed. codex-storymodel4s-scout: this supersedes the earlier 'store (kind, keyId)' wording where they differ; combine with the five items already on the bead.
